# Anstel Autonautics

> Autonautics is Anstel's connected operations platform, unifying fleet management, asset management, IoT monitoring, fleet security, last-mile delivery, and business intelligence into one intelligent ecosystem. It replaces disconnected fleet and operations software with a single platform that connects vehicles, drivers, assets, IoT devices, and business systems.

Anstel serves organizations in transportation, logistics, construction, mining, utilities, public services, and other asset-intensive industries. Autonautics products share one platform, one data model, and one set of integrations, so customers can start with a single product and expand without adding disconnected systems.

## Platform

- [Autonautics](https://www.anstelglobal.com/platform/): Overview of Anstel's Connected Operations Platform — how it connects assets, people, IoT devices, and business systems, and how its products work together.
- [Device Ecosystem](https://www.anstelglobal.com/platform/device-ecosystem/): The connected hardware layer of Autonautics — GPS trackers, AI cameras, IoT sensors, safety/security hardware, and mobile devices, all managed from one platform.

## Products

- [Connected Fleet](https://www.anstelglobal.com/platform/connected-fleet/): Core fleet management product — GPS tracking, driver management, maintenance, compliance, and reporting.
- [Last Mile](https://www.anstelglobal.com/platform/last-mile/): Delivery execution app for dispatch, route navigation, live tracking, and digital proof of delivery.
- [Security Monitor](https://www.anstelglobal.com/platform/security-monitor/): Security operations center for vehicle and driver security, SOS response, and incident coordination.
- [Merchant](https://www.anstelglobal.com/platform/merchant/): Marketplace connecting fleet operators with trusted mobility partners (insurance, servicing, finance, roadside assistance).
- [IoT](https://www.anstelglobal.com/platform/iot/): Connects devices, sensors, machines, and industrial assets into one monitoring and automation platform.
- [Job Scheduling](https://www.anstelglobal.com/platform/job-scheduling/): Plans, dispatches, and tracks field jobs and workforce scheduling.

## Solutions

- [Fleet Management](https://www.anstelglobal.com/solutions/fleet-management/): Complete fleet operations — vehicles, drivers, assets, and maintenance in one platform.
- [Fleet Tracking](https://www.anstelglobal.com/solutions/fleet-tracking/): Real-time vehicle location, video telematics, and journey history.
- [Driver Management](https://www.anstelglobal.com/solutions/driver-management/): Driver profiles, performance scorecards, compliance, and safety coaching.
- [Asset Management](https://www.anstelglobal.com/solutions/asset-management/): Tracking and lifecycle management for non-vehicle fleet and operational assets.
- [Maintenance Management](https://www.anstelglobal.com/solutions/maintenance-management/): Preventive maintenance scheduling, service history, and compliance tracking.
- [Dispatch Management](https://www.anstelglobal.com/solutions/dispatch-management/): Intelligent job assignment based on driver availability, vehicle capacity, and location.
- [Inventory Management](https://www.anstelglobal.com/solutions/inventory-management/): Stock visibility, warehouse operations, and field inventory tracking.
- [Fleet Security](https://www.anstelglobal.com/solutions/fleet-security/): Security monitoring, SOS response, and vehicle immobilization for fleet protection.

## Advanced Capabilities

- [Video Telematics](https://www.anstelglobal.com/solutions/video-telematics/): Live camera monitoring, AI event detection, and incident video evidence.
- [Fuel Management](https://www.anstelglobal.com/solutions/fuel-management/): OBD-based fuel monitoring and fuel reporting.
- [Route Optimization](https://www.anstelglobal.com/solutions/route-optimization/): Intelligent route planning, live ETA, and route performance analytics.
- [Compliance](https://www.anstelglobal.com/solutions/compliance/): Centralized compliance management, including AIS-140 and regional regulatory requirements.
- [Emergency Response](https://www.anstelglobal.com/solutions/emergency-response/): Real-time incident detection, live operational context, coordinated response workflows, and post-incident performance insights.
- [Reports & Analytics](https://www.anstelglobal.com/solutions/reports-analytics/): Real-time analytics, dynamic reporting, and business intelligence across the platform.
- [Alerts & Notifications](https://www.anstelglobal.com/solutions/alerts-notifications/): Real-time alerting and notification management for fleet events.
- [API & Integrations](https://www.anstelglobal.com/solutions/api-integrations/): Open APIs and integrations with ERP, CRM, HRMS, and third-party business systems.
